description:
Look up substances by name on one regulatory axis (same as HTTP GET /v1/substances?name=…).
The name is normalised (NFKC, whitespace removed, lower-cased) and matched **exactly** against the names and aliases the axis itself uses in that language (E numbers and official names for EU, 品目名 and label terms for JP, CFR names for US) — no partial or fuzzy matching. The official name is an alias of itself.
Returns the matching substances (SubstanceSummary: facts from their own roster only) and, per row, what text matched.
`axis` and `lang` must be one of the accepted pairs: JP+ja, US+en, EU+nl, EU+fr, EU+de, EU+es, EU+pl, EU+el, EU+bg.
Not a safety judgement: every record is a draft and needs verification.

axis.description: Regulatory axis the label or name belongs to: JP, EU or US.

lang.description: Language of the name or label text (ISO 639-1), e.g. ja, en, de, fr.

name.description: The name to look up, as printed on a label or roster.

name: search_substances
title: Look up substances by name
